name: io.github.t4dhg/mcp-holded
title: MCP Holded
description: MCP server for Holded (Spanish ERP): invoicing, accounting, treasury, CRM, projects, payroll.

environmentVariables.name: HOLDED_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Holded v2 Personal Access Token (pat_<id>_<secret>), created under Settings, Developers, API. A v1 key is rejected at startup.

environmentVariables.name: HOLDED_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the API base URL (default: https://api.holded.com/api/v2)

environmentVariables.name: HOLDED_MAX_RETRIES
environmentVariables.description: Retry attempts for GET requests; writes are never retried (default: 3)
